split.name: fixed-evaluation
split.method: Twelve CivitAI nsfwLevel=X records selected by ascending SHA-256(seed + filename), followed by six licensed Commons photos, six licensed ordinary illustrations, and the existing user-reported false positive. No model tuning uses these cases.

labelPolicy.yes: CivitAI dataset nsfwLevel=X. This is a source-provided NSFW level, not an independent human claim that every image depicts a sex act or pornography.
labelPolicy.no: Nonsexual subject matter in the cited licensed photo/illustration, or the user-reported false-positive label for the existing local fixture.
labelPolicy.drawingRule: A drawing is not positive merely because it is drawn. All six ordinary illustration controls are labeled no; X-level content is positive from the dataset label, not from its medium.

modelRuns.name: NSFWJS MobileNetV2 baseline
modelRuns.quantization: float32 TensorFlow.js graph model, bundled package assets
modelRuns.preprocessing: NSFWJS MobileNetV2 default input size 224; TensorFlow.js browser backend selected by tf.ready().

modelRuns.name: MobileNetV4 Conv Small NSFW classifier
modelRuns.preprocessing: RGB; timm input_size 224; resize shorter side to round(224 / 0.875) = 256, center-crop 224, bicubic resampling; scale [0,1], then normalize by mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].

modelRuns.name: Falconsai NSFW image detector (q4 ONNX)
modelRuns.preprocessing: Transformers.js ViT processor from the pinned repository config; RGB 224x224, scale by 1/255, normalize mean/std [0.5, 0.5, 0.5].

modelRuns.name: NSFWJS MobileNetV2 (pinned static weights; deferred fetch)
modelRuns.preprocessing: NSFWJS core classify(data URL): RGB pixels, divide by 255, bilinear resize with alignCorners=true to 224x224; return Drawing/Hentai/Porn/Sexy categories.
